nodes.label: Authoritative Artifact Contract
nodes.rationale: Authoritative artifacts require typed, versioned, attributable metadata, validated references and authorization, recorded review, and a registered semantic checksum.

nodes.label: Immutable Accepted Revision
nodes.rationale: Accepted artifacts remain immutable; material changes create new revisions and invalidate affected downstream artifacts.

nodes.label: Exact Human Approval Record
nodes.rationale: Human approvals are separate records tied to the exact evaluated revision and semantic checksum.

nodes.label: Authoritative Markdown and JSON Projection Parity
nodes.rationale: Structured Markdown is authoritative and its JSON projection must render back to the same content.
nodes.norm_label: authoritative markdown and json projection parity

nodes.label: Three-Cycle Scenario Revision Limit
nodes.rationale: Material scenario changes create a new revision, reset evaluation and review, retain removed IDs with reasons, and are bounded to three revision cycles.

nodes.label: Semantic Graph Refresh
nodes.rationale: Markdown and other semantic-input changes require the full Graphify update workflow, while code-only changes use the repository refresh command.

nodes.label: Versioned Capability Classifier
nodes.rationale: Unsupported Playwright actions become capability proposals whose disposition is computed by versioned policy rather than subjective agent judgment.

nodes.label: Scenario Evaluation Dispositions
nodes.rationale: Evaluation returns PASS only with no material finding, REVISE for correctable findings, and BLOCKED for insufficient requirements or authorization.

nodes.label: Advisory Scoped Knowledge
nodes.rationale: Only approved, current, exact-scope lessons may influence new work, and current approved requirements remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Inert Untrusted Requirement Input
nodes.rationale: Requirement sources are preserved and parsed as inert bounded data without executing embedded content, links, macros, or instructions.

nodes.label: SCRIPT_ERROR Repair Gate
nodes.rationale: Only an exact SCRIPT_ERROR classification permits a next-revision test repair, with no more than three attempts.

nodes.label: Human-Gated Quality Workflow
nodes.rationale: Independent agent evaluation precedes human review, exact human approval precedes Playwright generation, and final agent assessment cannot replace final human review.

nodes.label: Harness Remediation Program
nodes.rationale: The bounded remediation program strengthens artifact integrity, scenario quality, safe Playwright capabilities, and complete browser evidence without weakening human or security gates.

nodes.label: Canonical Harness Integrity
nodes.rationale: Authoritative contracts are schema-parsed, canonically serialized, and semantically checksummed as one ordered pipeline.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Browser Preflight
nodes.rationale: Playwright execution uses bounded typed actions, fail-closed preflight, a Chromium smoke, and then the registered three-browser matrix.

nodes.label: Policy-Driven Agent Autonomy
nodes.rationale: Human authority governs intent and external impact while versioned deterministic policy permits bounded, reversible routine mechanics.
